recommendedExpansionOpportunities.rationale: 5 cuisines have fewer than 3 recipes; jambalaya, paella, and gumbo add distinct techniques.
Butter chicken, paprikash, and cacciatore introduce simmered sauces unlike existing creamy pasta clusters.
Ramen and pho are materially different from existing chicken-rice bowl archetype.
Tourtière, Montreal smoked meat, and donair platters are absent and culturally distinct for Canadian fire halls.
Souvlaki, shawarma, and peri peri add grill-forward formats without repeating sheet-pan chicken.
Cottage and shepherd's pie introduce mashed-top bakes not represented in the catalog.

rejectionPatterns.pattern: Another taco variation with only minor changes
Another burger with minor topping changes

noveltyGate.description: New recipes must score >= 8/10 novelty vs the full catalog (10 - maxSimilarity/10). Reject burrito bowls, chicken rice bowls, creamy chicken pasta, minor taco/burger/sheet-pan variants.
